Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an eight-column, four-row attack atlas. Images 2, 3 and 4 are authoritative ORIGINAL CHARACTER AND PIXEL-STYLE REFERENCES (idle, run, original attack).
Primary request: correct every character in Image 1 so it is unmistakably the SAME fighter as the original references, drawn by the same pixel artist. The current target is too detailed and has drifted anatomy/costume; replace that styling.
Identity lock: the original slim wandering samurai: broad low burgundy/brown conical hat, shaded face, red scarf, light grey/beige jacket with muted burgundy panels, loose dark brown hakama, simple sandals, thin violet-grey katana/scabbard. Preserve the original hat silhouette and slim proportions.
Style lock: original low-resolution arcade pixel art, limited original palette, clean dark contour, deliberate flat pixel clusters. Think the original roughly56-source-pixel-tall character enlarged exactly2x by nearest neighbour into this larger atlas. Source-pixel clusters should be crisp2x2 blocks, not tiny noisy pixels, painted shading, antialiasing, realistic muscles or high-detail concept art.
Layout lock: preserve the exact2:1 canvas aspect,1774x887 output if possible, eight equal columns and four equal rows,32 separate full-body frames, one fighter per cell, unchanged cell order, camera, facing-right orientation, foot baseline and broad pose trajectory. No visible grid or text. Keep every sword/effect inside its own cell.
Rows:1 quick horizontal slash;2 reverse/cross cut;3 spinning combo finisher;4 heavy overhead cleave. Preserve those visibly different authored poses and their eight-frame windup/contact/recovery progression; do not substitute the same swing four times.
Match size, hat/head, face, coat panels, scarf/hair, trousers and weapon consistently in ALL32 frames. The original reference strips, not the target's redesign, define the character. Clean simple white sword arcs only where present. No red/magenta noisy edge halos.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha; no black background, checkerboard, ground, shadows, captions or watermark.
Return ONLY the corrected eight-by-four atlas.
